claim: The Ambasthala commemorative stele records completion of the restored Mihindu Seya and its Poson-poya commemoration on 21 June 2024.
bounded_by: Primary evidence for the 2024 commemorative act only; it does not validate the ancient events retold on the same stone.
notes: Modern inscription treated as contemporary primary evidence, not as an automatic T0 anchor for antiquity.
